title: Derived exchange for an arbitrary commutative square of schemes
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$ and $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with a specified equality $fg'=gf'$. No cartesian hypothesis or chosen pullback identification is part of this datum. For every corner $T$, use the bounded below derived category $\Dplus(T_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For each edge $u$, use the exact inverse image on these derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], the derived direct image $Ru_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and the canonical adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*$, with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction].

Write $c^D_{u,v}:v^{-1}u^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(uv)^{-1}$ for the composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-composition]. Define the commutative-square inverse-image isomorphism by the composite
$$
\theta:f'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{c^D_{g,f'}}(gf')^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(fg')^{-1}\xrightarrow{(c^D_{f,g'})^{-1}}g'^{-1}f^{-1},
$$
where the middle isomorphism is transport along the specified equality $gf'=fg'$.

The derived exchange for this commutative square is the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of $\theta$ under $f^{-1}\dashv Rf_*$ and $f'^{-1}\dashv Rf'_*$, a natural transformation
$$
\operatorname{Ex}:g^{-1}Rf_*\longrightarrow Rf'_*g'^{-1}.
$$
Explicitly, for $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$, its component is
$$
g^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\eta_{f',g^{-1}Rf_*K}}Rf'_*f'^{-1}g^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{Rf'_*(\theta_{Rf_*K})}Rf'_*g'^{-1}f^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{Rf'_*g'^{-1}(\varepsilon_{f,K})}Rf'_*g'^{-1}K.
$$
This definition specifies a morphism, without asserting that it is an isomorphism.
